            from app.services.image_utils import is_image
            if not is_image(content):
                raise HTTPException(400, "文件不是有效的图片，请重新选择")
            fname = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
            result = save_image(content, abs_subdir, rel_subdir, fname)
            vouchers.append(result["path"])

    # 更新字段
    r.category_id = category_id
    r.account_id = account_id
    r.amount = amount
    r.currency = currency
    r.expense_date = datetime.fromisoformat(expense_date)
    if supplier_id is not None:
        r.supplier_id = supplier_id
    r.remark = remark
    r.voucher = json.dumps(vouchers, ensure_ascii=False) if vouchers else None
    await costs.sync(db,'expense',r,current_user,supplier=r.supplier_id,
        identity=costs.parse_identity(invoice_identity,current_user) if invoice_identity is not None else costs.UNSET,
        confirmation=cost_confirmation)

    await db.flush()
    await record_history(db, module="expense", record_id=r.id, operator=current_user,
                          operation_type="edit", before=before, after={
                              "amount": amount, "currency": currency,
                              "expense_date": expense_date, "category_id": category_id,
                              "account_id": account_id, "supplier_id": r.supplier_id,
                              "remark": remark, "voucher": r.voucher,
                          }, warehouse_id=r.warehouse_id)
    return {"message": "更新成功", "voucher": r.voucher}

async def flow_list(db, warehouse_ids, start, end, *, page=1, page_size=30, account_id=None, currency_code=None, source=None, flow_type=None, unassigned=False):
    q = flow_query(db, warehouse_ids)
    filters = flow_filters(q, start, end, account_id=account_id, currency_code=currency_code, source=source, flow_type=flow_type, unassigned=unassigned)
    total = (await db.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(q).where(*filters))).scalar_one()
    rows = (await db.execute(select(q).where(*filters).order_by(q.c.date.desc(), q.c.source, q.c.id.desc())
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size))).mappings().all()
    accounts = {a.id: a.account_name for a in (await db.execute(select(PaymentAccount).where(PaymentAccount.warehouse_id.in_(warehouse_ids)))).scalars()}
    data = [{**dict(r), "date": str(r["date"]), "amount": float(r["amount"]), "status_label": "已冲销" if r["status"] == "revoked" else "有效",
        "account_name": accounts.get(r["account_id"], r["account_name"] or "未指定账户")} for r in rows]
    totals = (await db.execute(select(q.c.currency, q.c.type, func.sum(q.c.amount)).where(
        *filters, q.c.status == "active", literal(True) if account_id is not None else q.c.is_internal_transfer.is_(False)).group_by(q.c.currency, q.c.type))).all()
    inc = {c: float(money(a)) for c, kind, a in totals if kind == "income"}
    exp = {c: float(money(a)) for c, kind, a in totals if kind == "expense"}
    single = currency_code or (next(iter(set(inc) | set(exp))) if len(set(inc) | set(exp)) == 1 else None)
    total_income, total_expense = (inc.get(single, 0), exp.get(single, 0)) if single or not (inc or exp) else (None, None)
    # 无单一币种时不提供混币种金额；指定币种下保留原流水页净额颜色。
    from app.services.internal_transfers import transfer_summary
    transfers = await transfer_summary(db, warehouse_ids, start, end, account_id=account_id, currency=currency_code,
        source=source, flow_type=flow_type, unassigned=unassigned)
    return {"data": data, "internal_transfers": transfers, "total": total, "page": page, "page_size": page_size,
        "income_by_currency": inc, "expense_by_currency": exp, "total_income": total_income,
        "total_expense": total_expense, "net": total_income - total_expense if total_income is not None else None, "flow_scope": "company"}

@router.get("/operating-dashboard", dependencies=[Depends(require_non_labor)])
async def operating_dashboard(
    start_date: str = None,
    end_date: str = None,
    month: str = None, year: str = None,
    selected_ids: list[int] = Depends(selected_wallet_warehouses),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _perm=Depends(check_staff_permission("运营收支")),
):
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    import calendar

    today = thai_today()

    start, end = money_period(month, start_date, end_date, year=year,
        default_start=today.replace(day=1), default_end=today)

    wh_ids = selected_ids
    from app.services.wallet import flow_query, grouped_totals
    from collections import defaultdict
    q = flow_query(db, wh_ids)
    rows = (await db.execute(select(q.c.date, q.c.currency, q.c.type, q.c.amount).where(
        q.c.date >= start, q.c.date <= end, q.c.status == "active", q.c.is_internal_transfer.is_(False)))).all()
    granularity = "day" if (end - start).days <= 31 else "month"
    grouped = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(float))
    total = defaultdict(float)
    for day, cur, kind, value in rows:
        label = day.isoformat() if granularity == "day" else day.strftime("%Y-%m")
        grouped[label][(cur, kind)] += float(value)
        total[(cur, kind)] += float(value)
    data, cursor = [], start
    while cursor <= end:
        label = cursor.isoformat() if granularity == "day" else cursor.strftime("%Y-%m")
        block = grouped_totals([(cur, kind, n) for (cur, kind), n in grouped[label].items()])
        data.append({"label": label, "recharge_income": block["total_income"],
            "operating_expense": block["total_expense"], **block})
        cursor = cursor + timedelta(days=1) if granularity == "day" else (cursor.replace(day=28) + timedelta(days=4)).replace(day=1)
    result = grouped_totals([(cur, kind, n) for (cur, kind), n in total.items()])
    transfers = await transfer_summary(db, wh_ids, start, end)
    return {"internal_transfers": transfers, "data": data, "granularity": granularity, "start_date": start.isoformat(), "end_date": end.isoformat(),
        **result, "total_net": result["net"]}

async def fund_sources(db, fund):
    """只读先拨先用分摊；无法还原的老资金明确标历史余额，不伪造拨付编号。"""
    rows = (await db.execute(select(ExpenseFundDisbursement).where(
        ExpenseFundDisbursement.fund_id == fund.id, ExpenseFundDisbursement.warehouse_id == fund.warehouse_id,
    ).order_by(ExpenseFundDisbursement.created_at, ExpenseFundDisbursement.id))).scalars().all()
    items = (await db.execute(select(ExpenseFundItem).where(ExpenseFundItem.fund_id == fund.id)
        .order_by(ExpenseFundItem.created_at, ExpenseFundItem.id))).scalars().all()
    legacy = max(ZERO, money(fund.amount) - sum((r.amount for r in rows), ZERO))
    pools = [{"disbursement_id": None, "remaining": legacy, "label": "历史余额（原拨付编号未记录）"}]
    by_item = {}
    offset = 0
    for item in items:
        while offset < len(rows) and utc(rows[offset].created_at) <= utc(item.created_at):
            r = rows[offset]
            pools.append({"disbursement_id": r.id, "remaining": r.amount, "label": f"拨付 #{r.id}"})
            offset += 1
        if item.review_status == "rejected" or item.is_voided:
            by_item[item.id] = []
            continue
        remaining = money(item.amount)
        parts = []
        # 旧混币种开销不能冒充消耗本币的新拨付。
        if (item.currency or "THB") == (fund.currency or "THB"):
            for pool in pools:
                used = min(remaining, pool["remaining"])
                if used > 0:
                    parts.append({"disbursement_id": pool["disbursement_id"], "amount": float(used), "label": pool["label"]})
                    pool["remaining"] -= used
                    remaining -= used
        if remaining > 0:
            parts.append({"disbursement_id": None, "amount": float(remaining), "label": "历史来源未记录"})
        by_item[item.id] = parts
    return rows, by_item

async def create_disbursement(db, fund, amount, payment_account_id, operator, *, receive_date=None, request_id=None):
    amount = validate_amount(amount)
    when = disbursement_date(receive_date)
    if not payment_account_id:
        raise HTTPException(400, "请选择备用金拨付账户")
    # 调用者已锁备用金账户；付款账户也锁定，避免并发拨付越过余额。
    account = (await db.execute(select(PaymentAccount).where(
        PaymentAccount.id == payment_account_id, PaymentAccount.warehouse_id == fund.warehouse_id,
    ).with_for_update())).scalar_one_or_none()
    if account is None:
        raise HTTPException(400, "付款账户不存在或不属于当前仓库")
    if account.status not in (None, "active"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "付款账户已停用")
    currency = fund.currency or "THB"
    if (account.currency or "THB") != currency:
        raise HTTPException(400, "付款账户币种必须与备用金账户一致")
    from app.services.account_balances import current_account_balances
    before_balance = (await current_account_balances(db, [account]))[account.id]
    if before_balance < amount:
        raise HTTPException(400, "付款账户余额不足")
    await db.execute(select(Warehouse.id).where(Warehouse.id == fund.warehouse_id).with_for_update())
    category = (await db.execute(select(IncomeExpenseCategory).where(
        IncomeExpenseCategory.warehouse_id == fund.warehouse_id, IncomeExpenseCategory.type == "expense",
        IncomeExpenseCategory.category_group == "operating", IncomeExpenseCategory.name == CATEGORY,
    ).order_by(IncomeExpenseCategory.id).limit(1))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if category is None:
        category = IncomeExpenseCategory(warehouse_id=fund.warehouse_id, type="expense", category_group="operating",
            name=CATEGORY, status="active", sort_order=111)
        db.add(category)
        await db.flush()
    if category.status != "active":
        raise HTTPException(400, "备用金拨付支出分类已停用")
    who = await db.get(User, fund.employee_id)
    warehouse = await db.get(Warehouse, fund.warehouse_id)
    remark = f"拨给{who.display_name if who else fund.employee_id} {warehouse.name} 备用金"
    expense = ExpenseRecord(warehouse_id=fund.warehouse_id, category_id=category.id, account_id=account.id,
        amount=float(amount), currency=currency, expense_date=when, remark=remark, approved_by=operator.id)
    db.add(expense)
    await db.flush()
    row = ExpenseFundDisbursement(warehouse_id=fund.warehouse_id, fund_id=fund.id, amount=amount,
        currency=currency, disbursed_date=when, payment_account_id=account.id, account_name=account.account_name,
        expense_record_id=expense.id, recharge_request_id=request_id,
        operator_id=operator.id, operator_name=operator.display_name, remark=remark)
    db.add(row)
    fund.remaining_balance = float(money(fund.remaining_balance) + amount)
    fund.amount = float(money(fund.amount) + amount)
    # receive_date 保留旧累计记录的历史日期；新拨付日期在逐笔记录中单独保存。
    await db.flush()
    await record_history(db, module="expense", record_id=expense.id, operator=operator,
        operation_type="create", after={"fund_disbursement_id": row.id, "fund_id": fund.id,
            "amount": float(amount), "currency": currency, "account_id": account.id,
            "expense_date": when.date().isoformat(), "remark": remark}, warehouse_id=fund.warehouse_id)
    await record_history(db, module="expense_fund", record_id=fund.id, operator=operator,
        operation_type="disburse", after={"disbursement_id": row.id, "expense_record_id": expense.id,
            "amount": float(amount), "currency": currency, "payment_account_id": account.id}, warehouse_id=fund.warehouse_id)
    return {**disbursement_fields(row), "account_balance": float(before_balance - amount),
        "new_balance": fund.remaining_balance, "total_topped_up": fund.amount}

    account_id: int, req: FundItemCreate,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _perm=Depends(check_staff_permission("备用金管理")),
):
    """添加开销记录"""
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")

    account = (await db.execute(select(ExpenseFund).where(ExpenseFund.id == account_id))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not account:
        raise HTTPException(404, "账户不存在")
    if account.warehouse_id not in get_wh_ids(current_user):
        raise HTTPException(403, "只能操作本仓库的备用金账户")
    costs.number(req.request_key,'登记请求编号',100)
    await costs.lock(db,account.warehouse_id)
    account=(await db.execute(select(ExpenseFund).where(ExpenseFund.id==account_id).with_for_update().execution_options(populate_existing=True))).scalar_one()
    signature=costs.fingerprint({'fund_id':account_id,**req.model_dump(exclude={'cost_confirmation'})})
    previous=await costs.replay(db,'fund_item',account.warehouse_id,req.request_key,signature)
    if previous:return {'id':previous.id,'replayed':True,'message':'原开销已保存，未重复登记','receipt':previous.receipt,**await costs.metadata_for(db,previous)}
    if req.amount is None or req.amount <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(400, "开销金额必须大于0")
    if (req.currency or "THB") != (account.currency or "THB"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "开销币种必须与备用金账户一致")
    receipt = _required_receipt(req.receipt, account)

    # 超支守卫：常规开销（非报销）不得超过备用金里的现金余额
    # （报销类开销走报销流程，创建时已扣减 remaining_balance，这里不重复限制）
    if req.category != "报销":
        spent_regular = float((await db.execute(
            select(func.coalesce(func.sum(ExpenseFundItem.amount), 0)).where(
                ExpenseFundItem.fund_id == account_id,
                ExpenseFundItem.category != "报销",
                ExpenseFundItem.review_status != ReviewStatus.REJECTED.value, ExpenseFundItem.not_voided(),
            )
        )).scalar() or 0)
        from app.services.flow_rules import fund_available
        available = fund_available(account.remaining_balance, spent_regular)
        if req.amount > available:
            raise HTTPException(400, f"超出备用金可用余额（可用 {available:,.2f}），请先充值或核减")

    i = ExpenseFundItem(
        fund_id=account_id, expense_date=datetime.fromisoformat(req.expense_date),
        category=req.category, amount=req.amount, currency=req.currency or "THB",
        description=req.description, receipt=receipt,
    )
    db.add(i)
    await db.flush()
    root=await costs.sync(db,'fund_item',i,current_user,supplier=req.supplier_id,
        identity=costs.parse_identity(req.invoice_identity,current_user),confirmation=req.cost_confirmation,
        key=req.request_key,signature=signature)
    _, sources = await fund_sources(db, account)
    return {"id": i.id, "message": "开销记录添加成功", "receipt": i.receipt, "cost_record_only": True,**costs.metadata(root),
            "disbursement_sources": sources.get(i.id, [])}

async def _save_receipt(file, account):
    from app.services.image_utils import is_image, save_image
    content = await file.read(10 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
    if not content or len(content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise HTTPException(400, "开销凭证大小须在10MB以内")
    if not is_image(content):
        raise HTTPException(400, "请上传有效的开销凭证照片")
    folder = f"fund_receipts/{account.warehouse_id}/{account.id}"
    # 以图片实际格式决定后缀，不信任上传文件名；沿用统一压缩和缩略图处理。
    import io
    from PIL import Image
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(content)) as photo:
        ext = {"JPEG": "jpg", "PNG": "png", "WEBP": "webp", "GIF": "gif"}.get(photo.format)
    if not ext:
        raise HTTPException(400, "请上传 JPG、PNG、WebP 或 GIF 开销凭证照片")
    return save_image(content, str(Path(UPLOAD_DIR) / folder), f"/uploads/{folder}", f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}")

def usage_amounts(advance, used, reimbursement_used=Decimal("0"), employee_advance_used=Decimal("0")):
    outstanding = max(advance.amount - advance.repaid_amount, Decimal("0"))
    unused = max(advance.amount - used, Decimal("0"))
    available = max(min(outstanding, advance.amount - used - reimbursement_used - employee_advance_used), Decimal("0"))
    return {
        "payroll_used_amount": float(used),
        "payroll_unused_amount": float(unused),
        "reimbursement_used_amount": float(reimbursement_used), "employee_advance_used_amount": float(employee_advance_used),
        "total_used_amount": float(used + reimbursement_used + employee_advance_used),
        "available_amount": float(available) if advance.status == "confirmed" else 0.0,
        "payroll_available_amount": float(available) if advance.status == "confirmed" and advance.currency == PAYROLL_CURRENCY else 0.0,
    }

    if req.is_fund_linked == "1":

        ))).scalar_one_or_none()

            raise HTTPException(400, f"备用金余额不足（当前余额: {fund.remaining_balance:,.0f}，报销金额: {total:,.0f}）")

        # 扣减备用金

            description=f"来自报销管理: {descriptions}",

    r = Reimbursement(

        funding_source="expense_fund" if req.is_fund_linked == "1" else None,
        status=ReimbStatus.FUND_LINKED.value if req.is_fund_linked == "1" else ReimbStatus.PENDING.value,
    )
    db.add(r); await db.flush()
    for item in req.items:
        db.add(ReimbursementItem(reimbursement_id=r.id, category=item.category,
                                 amount=item.amount, description=item.description, receipt=item.receipt))
    await db.flush()

                              "items": [{"category": i.category, "amount": i.amount, "description": i.description} for i in req.items],
                          }, warehouse_id=wh_id)

async def pay(db, r, req, user):
    if r.status not in ("approved", "partially_approved"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "该报销单已付款" if r.status == "paid" else "仅已审批状态可付款")
    if r.expense_record_id is not None or await active_payment_map(db, [r]):
        raise HTTPException(400, "该报销单已有付款记录，请先核对")
    source = req.funding_source or ("expense_fund" if r.is_fund_linked == "1" else "company_account")
    if r.is_fund_linked == "1" and source != "expense_fund":
        raise HTTPException(400, "该报销已关联备用金，请使用备用金扣款")
    if r.is_fund_linked != "1" and source == "expense_fund":
        raise HTTPException(400, "该报销未关联备用金，不能选择备用金扣款")
    if source != "company_account" and req.payment_account_id is not None:
        raise HTTPException(400, "该资金来源不应选择公司账户")
    if source != "cash_advance" and req.cash_advance_id is not None:
        raise HTTPException(400, "该资金来源不应选择垫款单")
    amount, now, previous = money(r.total_amount), thai_now(), r.status
    account, advance, fund, item, voucher = None, None, None, None, None
    if source != "expense_fund":
        voucher = validate_voucher(req.payment_voucher_path, r.warehouse_id)
        if req.payment_method not in ("cash", "transfer"): raise HTTPException(400, "请选择现金或转账付款方式")
        if source == "company_account":
            account = await payment_account(db, r, req.payment_account_id)
            from app.services.account_balances import current_account_balances
            if (await current_account_balances(db, [account]))[account.id] < amount:
                raise HTTPException(400, "公司账户余额不足")
        else: advance = await lock_advance(db, r, req.cash_advance_id, amount)
    else:
        fund, item = await fund_details(db, r)
    r.funding_source = source
    r.payment_account_id = account.id if account else None
    r.cash_advance_id = advance.id if advance else None
    r.payment_method = req.payment_method if source != "expense_fund" else None
    r.payment_voucher_path = voucher
    expense = await create_cost(db, r, amount, r.payment_account_id, voucher, user, now) if source == "company_account" else None
    p = ReimbursementPayment(reimbursement_id=r.id, warehouse_id=r.warehouse_id, amount=amount,
        currency=(r.currency or "THB").upper(), funding_source=source, payment_account_id=r.payment_account_id,
        account_name=account.account_name if account else None, cash_advance_id=r.cash_advance_id,
        payment_method=r.payment_method, voucher_path=voucher, expense_record_id=expense.id if expense else None,
        previous_status=previous, paid_by_id=user.id, paid_by_name=user.display_name, paid_at=now, status="active",
        fund_id=fund.id if fund else None, fund_item_snapshot=fund_snapshot(item) if item else None)
    db.add(p)
    r.status, r.paid_at = "paid", now
    await db.flush()
    output = await result(db, r, p, account)
    await record_history(db, module="reimbursement", record_id=r.id, operator=user, operation_type="pay",
        before={"status": previous}, after=output, warehouse_id=r.warehouse_id)
    if advance:
        await record_history(db, module="cash_advances", record_id=advance.id, operator=user, operation_type="reimbursement_use",
            after={"reimbursement_id": r.id, "payment_id": p.id, "amount": float(amount), "currency": p.currency}, warehouse_id=r.warehouse_id)
    return {"message": "付款成功", **output}

async def record_payment(db, bill, value, account_id, method, operator, request_key=None):
    if request_key:
        old = (await db.execute(select(PayablePayment).where(PayablePayment.request_key == request_key))).scalar_one_or_none()
        if old:
            if old.bill_id != bill.id or old.warehouse_id != bill.warehouse_id or old.account_id != account_id or money(old.amount) != money(value):
                raise HTTPException(409, '付款请求已使用，请刷新后重试')
            return old
    if bill.status in ('voided', 'paid'): raise HTTPException(400, '已作废或已付清的账单不能付款')
    if bill.need_boss_confirm == 'true': raise HTTPException(400, '该账单存在收货差异，需老板确认后才能付款')
    n = positive_money(value)
    remaining = money(bill.amount) - money(bill.paid_amount)
    if n > remaining: raise HTTPException(400, '付款金额不能超过剩余应付')
    from app.services.purchase_matching import check_payment
    await check_payment(db,bill,n)
    account = await lock_account(db, bill.warehouse_id, account_id, bill.currency or 'THB')
    balance = (await current_account_balances(db, [account]))[account.id]
    if balance < n: raise HTTPException(400, f'公司账户余额不足（可用 {balance:,.2f}）')
    if bill.legacy_paid_amount is None:
        bill.legacy_paid_amount, bill.legacy_paid_at = bill.paid_amount or 0, bill.paid_at
    now = thai_now()
    row = PayablePayment(warehouse_id=bill.warehouse_id, bill_id=bill.id, account_id=account.id,
        amount=n, currency=bill.currency or 'THB', paid_at=now, payment_method=method, operator_id=operator.id, request_key=request_key)
    db.add(row)
    bill.paid_amount = float(money(bill.paid_amount) + n)
    bill.paid_at, bill.payment_method = now, method
    bill.status = 'paid' if money(bill.paid_amount) >= money(bill.amount) else 'partially_paid'
    from app.services.cost_identity import paid
    await paid(db,'payable',bill,operator)
    await db.flush()
    await record_history(db, module='payable', record_id=bill.id, operator=operator,
        operation_type='pay', after={'payment_id': row.id, 'amount': float(n), 'account_id': account.id,
            'currency': row.currency, 'paid_at': now.isoformat()}, warehouse_id=bill.warehouse_id)
    return row

async def matching(db, bill, po=None):
    from app.models import PayableBill
    from app.services.supplier_payable_read import checked_link
    configuration = await policy(db, bill.warehouse_id)
    document_kind = bill.matching_kind or 'unknown'
    result = {'kind': document_kind, 'kind_label': KINDS.get(document_kind,'类型待核实'),
        'policy': configuration, 'quantity_match': 'unknown', 'amount_match': 'unknown',
        'receipt_quantity_match': 'unknown', 'line_amount_match': 'unknown', 'payment_cap': None, 'currency': bill.currency,
        'notes': [], 'lines': [], 'status': 'unknown'}
    if po is None and bill.purchase_order_id:
        po = await db.get(PurchaseOrder, bill.purchase_order_id)
    if bill.purchase_order_id and po is None:
        raise HTTPException(409, '关联采购单缺失，请管理员核对')
    state = None
    if po:
        await checked_link(db,bill,po,bill.warehouse_id)
        state = await receipt_state(db,po)
        result['lines'] = state['items']; result['notes'].extend(state['issues'])
        result['purchase_order_id'] = po.id
        ordered_amount, invoiced_amount = amount(po.total_amount), amount(bill.amount)
        result.update(purchase_amount=float(ordered_amount) if ordered_amount is not None else None,
            bill_amount=float(invoiced_amount) if invoiced_amount is not None else None)
        result['amount_match'] = 'unknown' if ordered_amount is None or invoiced_amount is None else 'matched' if ordered_amount == invoiced_amount else 'different'
        result['receipt_quantity_match'] = ('unknown' if not state['has_recorded_receipt'] or state['issues'] or not state['items']
            else 'matched' if all(i['quantity_status']=='matched' for i in state['items'])
            else 'different' if any(i['quantity_status'] in ('short','over') for i in state['items']) else 'unknown')
        structured = bill.match_lines
        if isinstance(structured,dict) and isinstance(structured.get('items'),list):
            rows=structured['items']; m={r['line_id']:r for r in rows
                if isinstance(r,dict) and isinstance(r.get('line_id'),str) and r['line_id']}
            if len(m)==len(rows)==len(state['items']) and set(m)=={i['line_id'] for i in state['items']}:
                known = all(i.get('unit') and m[i['line_id']].get('unit') for i in state['items'])
                same = all(m[i['line_id']].get('quantity')==i.get('quantity') and m[i['line_id']].get('unit')==i.get('unit')
                    and m[i['line_id']].get('currency') == bill.currency for i in state['items'])
                result['quantity_match'] = 'unknown' if not known else 'matched' if same else 'different'
                prices_known=all(decimal(i.get('unit_price')) is not None and decimal(m[i['line_id']].get('unit_price')) is not None
                    and amount(i.get('subtotal')) is not None and amount(m[i['line_id']].get('subtotal')) is not None for i in state['items'])
                result['line_amount_match']='unknown' if not prices_known else 'matched' if all(
                    decimal(i.get('unit_price'))==decimal(m[i['line_id']].get('unit_price'))
                    and amount(i.get('subtotal'))==amount(m[i['line_id']].get('subtotal')) for i in state['items']) else 'different'
                if prices_known:
                    order_sum=sum((amount(i['subtotal']) for i in state['items']),Decimal(0))
                    bill_sum=sum((amount(r['subtotal']) for r in rows),Decimal(0))
                    arithmetic_known=all(historical_quantity(i.get('quantity')) is not None and historical_quantity(m[i['line_id']].get('quantity')) is not None for i in state['items'])
                    if not arithmetic_known:
                        result['line_amount_match']='unknown'
                    elif (order_sum!=ordered_amount or bill_sum!=invoiced_amount or any(
                            amount(decimal(i['unit_price'])*historical_quantity(i['quantity']))!=amount(i['subtotal'])
                            or amount(decimal(m[i['line_id']]['unit_price'])*historical_quantity(m[i['line_id']]['quantity']))!=amount(m[i['line_id']]['subtotal'])
                            for i in state['items'])):
                        result['line_amount_match']='different'
                        result['notes'].append('结构化行的单价×数量、小计或行合计与单据金额不一致；未改写金额。')
        if result['quantity_match']=='unknown': result['notes'].append('应付缺可靠结构化行或单位，数量三单匹配未知；未按名称或文字明细猜配。')
        cap = Decimal(0); cap_known = bool(state['items']) and not state['issues']
        for it in state['items']:
            price=decimal(it.get('unit_price')); ordered=historical_quantity(it.get('quantity')); received=it['received_quantity']
            if price is None or price < 0 or ordered is None or received is None or not it.get('unit'):
                cap_known=False;continue
            cap += min(ordered, received)*price
        result['payment_cap']=float(amount(cap)) if cap_known and amount(cap) is not None else None
        result['notes'].append(state['baseline'].get('note','历史来源未记录'))
    else:
        result['notes'].append('无真实采购关联，不能进行商品三单匹配；未补造采购或行映射。')
    if document_kind in ('prepayment','non_goods'):
        result['quantity_match']='not_applicable'; result['receipt_quantity_match']='not_applicable';result['payment_cap']=None
        result['status']='not_applicable'
        result['notes'].append('预付款或非商品费用不使用商品收货数量上限，仍保留原付款和老板复核规则。')
    elif document_kind=='goods' and all(result[k]=='matched' for k in ('quantity_match','receipt_quantity_match','amount_match','line_amount_match')):
        result['status']='matched'
    elif any(result[k] in ('different',) for k in ('quantity_match','receipt_quantity_match','amount_match','line_amount_match')):
        result['status']='different'
    snapshot = {'version':1,'bill':{k:getattr(bill,k) for k in ('id','warehouse_id','supplier_id','purchase_order_id','amount','currency','confirmed_amount','matching_kind','match_lines')},
        'purchase':None if po is None else {'id':po.id,'warehouse_id':po.warehouse_id,'supplier_id':po.supplier_id,
            'total_amount':po.total_amount,'currency':po.currency,'ordered_lines':[{k:i.get(k) for k in ('line_id','quantity','unit','unit_price','subtotal','currency')} for i in state['items']],
            'receipt_baseline':state['baseline'],'events':[{'id':e['id'],'status':e['status'],'items':e['items']} for e in state['batches']]}}
    result['snapshot']=snapshot; result['snapshot_hash']=fingerprint(snapshot)
    review=bill.match_review
    result['review']=review
    result['review_valid']=bool(review and review.get('snapshot_hash')==result['snapshot_hash'])
    result['review_status']='valid' if result['review_valid'] else 'stale' if review else 'not_reviewed'
    result['need_boss_confirm']=bill.need_boss_confirm=='true' or bool(review and not result['review_valid'])
    from app.models import DataChangeHistory
    history=(await db.execute(select(DataChangeHistory).where(DataChangeHistory.module=='payable',
        DataChangeHistory.warehouse_id==bill.warehouse_id,DataChangeHistory.record_id==bill.id,
        DataChangeHistory.operation_type.in_(['match_confirm','match_review_stale'])).order_by(DataChangeHistory.id))).scalars().all()
    result['review_history']=[{'id':h.id,'action':h.operation_type,'operator_name':h.operator_name,
        'created_at':h.created_at.isoformat(),'data':h.after_data} for h in history]
    return result

                    current_user: User = Depends(check_staff_permission(_PAYABLE_PERMISSION)),
                    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), warehouse_id: int = Depends(current_supplier_warehouse)):
    """作废账单（留痕，不真删）。仅仓库管理员/主管可操作。"""
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    if current_user.role not in (Role.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN, Role.SUPERVISOR):
        raise HTTPException(403, "无权限")
    await costs.lock(db,warehouse_id)
    b = (await db.execute(select(PayableBill).where(PayableBill.id == bill_id).with_for_update())).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not b:
        raise HTTPException(404, "账单不存在")
    if current_user.role != Role.SUPER_ADMIN and b.warehouse_id != warehouse_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "只能操作自己仓库的账单")
    if not void_reason or not str(void_reason).strip():
        raise HTTPException(400, "请填写作废原因")
    if b.status == PayableStatus.PAID.value:
        raise HTTPException(400, "已付款的账单不能作废")
    if b.status == PayableStatus.VOIDED.value:

@router.get("/trend")
async def payable_trend(
    months: int = 6,
    current_user: User = Depends(check_staff_permission(_PAYABLE_PERMISSION)),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    import calendar

    # Find consumable category id
    cat_result = await db.execute(select(SupplierCategory).where(SupplierCategory.name == "耗材商"))
    cat = cat_result.scalar_one_or_none()
    con_supplier_ids = []
    if cat:
        sup_result = await db.execute(select(Supplier.id).where(Supplier.category_id == cat.id))
        con_supplier_ids = [r[0] for r in sup_result.all()]

    today = thai_today()
    months_list = []
    for i in range(months - 1, -1, -1):
        m = today.month - i; y = today.year
        if m <= 0: m += 12; y -= 1
        months_list.append(f"{y}-{m:02d}")

    # Monthly order volumes
    order_q = select(MonthlyOrderVolume).where(
        MonthlyOrderVolume.warehouse_id.in_(get_wh_ids(current_user)),
        MonthlyOrderVolume.month.in_(months_list),
    )
    order_rows = (await db.execute(order_q)).scalars().all()
    order_map = {r.month: r.order_count for r in order_rows}

    # Monthly consumable spending
    spending_map = {}
    for month in months_list:
        m_start = datetime.fromisoformat(f"{month}-01")
        last_day = calendar.monthrange(int(month[:4]), int(month[5:]))[1]
        m_end = datetime.fromisoformat(f"{month}-{last_day:02d}") + timedelta(days=1) - timedelta(microseconds=1)
        q = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(PayableBill.amount), 0)).outerjoin(
            PurchaseOrder, PayableBill.purchase_order_id == PurchaseOrder.id
        ).where(
            PayableBill.warehouse_id.in_(get_wh_ids(current_user)),
            PayableBill.status != PayableStatus.VOIDED.value,
            PayableBill.bill_date >= m_start,
            PayableBill.bill_date <= m_end,
            (PayableBill.purchase_order_id.is_(None)) | (PurchaseOrder.status == "confirmed"),
        )
        if con_supplier_ids:
            q = q.where(PayableBill.supplier_id.in_(con_supplier_ids))
        total = float((await db.execute(q)).scalar() or 0)
        spending_map[month] = total

    # Build response
    data = []
    prev_order = None; prev_spending = None
    warnings = []
    for i, month in enumerate(months_list):
        order = order_map.get(month, 0)
        spending = spending_map.get(month, 0)
        data.append({"month": month, "order_count": order, "consumable_spending": spending})
        # Check anomaly: order flat/down but spending up > 20%
        if i > 0 and prev_order is not None and prev_spending is not None:
            if order <= prev_order and spending > prev_spending * 1.2:
                warnings.append(f"{month}: 订单量持平或下降，但耗材支出上涨超20%")
        prev_order = order; prev_spending = spending

    return {"data": data, "warnings": warnings}

def overdue_from_position(position, today):
    if position['outstanding'] <= 0: return 0
    receipts = [date.fromisoformat(e['date']) for e in position.get('events',[]) if e['source']=='incoming']
    shipments = [date.fromisoformat(e['date']) for e in position.get('events',[]) if e['source']=='shipment']
    reference = max(receipts) if receipts else max(shipments) if shipments else None
    return max((today-reference).days,0) if reference else 0

async def _compute_assessment(
    current_user: User, db: AsyncSession,
) -> dict:
    """核心评级计算逻辑，供端点和看板复用"""
    wh_id = get_wh_id(current_user)
    query = select(CreditCustomer).where(CreditCustomer.status == CreditStatus.ACTIVE.value)
    if current_user.role != Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        query = query.where(CreditCustomer.warehouse_id.in_(get_wh_ids(current_user)))
    records = (await db.execute(query)).scalars().all()

    cids = {r.customer_id for r in records}
    cmap = {}
    if cids:
        custs = (await db.execute(select(Customer).where(Customer.id.in_(cids)))).scalars().all()
        cmap = {c.id: {"name": c.company_name, "created_at": c.created_at} for c in custs}

    balances = await positions(db,get_wh_ids(current_user),[r.customer_id for r in records],sources=True)
    today = thai_today()
    data = []
    for r in records:
        cust_info = cmap.get(r.customer_id, {"name": "", "created_at": None})

        coop_months = 0
        if cust_info["created_at"] and hasattr(cust_info["created_at"], 'date'):
            coop_months = max(0, (today - cust_info["created_at"].date()).days // 30)

        reps = (await db.execute(
            select(CreditRepayment).where(CreditRepayment.credit_customer_id == r.id)
            .order_by(CreditRepayment.repayment_date.asc())
        )).scalars().all()

        ships = (await db.execute(
            select(CreditShipment).where(CreditShipment.credit_customer_id == r.id, active_shipment())
            .order_by(CreditShipment.ship_date.asc())
        )).scalars().all()

        total_repayments = len(reps)
        on_time_count = 0
        overdue_count = 0
        max_overdue_days = 0

        for rep in reps:
            rep_date = rep.repayment_date.date() if hasattr(rep.repayment_date, 'date') else rep.repayment_date
            relevant_ship_date = None
            for s in ships:
                sd = s.ship_date.date() if hasattr(s.ship_date, 'date') else s.ship_date
                if sd <= rep_date:
                    relevant_ship_date = sd
            if relevant_ship_date:
                days_since = (rep_date - relevant_ship_date).days
                if days_since <= (r.repayment_day or 15):
                    on_time_count += 1
                else:
                    overdue_count += 1
                    max_overdue_days = max(max_overdue_days, days_since - (r.repayment_day or 15))
            else:
                on_time_count += 1

        on_time_rate = round(on_time_count / total_repayments * 100, 1) if total_repayments > 0 else 100

        three_months_ago = today.replace(day=1)
        if three_months_ago.month > 2:
            three_months_ago = three_months_ago.replace(month=three_months_ago.month - 2)
        else:
            three_months_ago = three_months_ago.replace(year=three_months_ago.year - 1, month=three_months_ago.month + 10)

        recent_reps = [rep for rep in reps if rep.repayment_date and
                       (rep.repayment_date.date() if hasattr(rep.repayment_date, 'date') else rep.repayment_date) >= three_months_ago]
        avg_monthly_repay = round(sum(rp.amount for rp in recent_reps) / 3, 1) if recent_reps else 0

        customer = await db.get(Customer,r.customer_id)
        currency = currency_of(r,customer)
        factual_debt = balances.get(r.customer_id,{}).get(currency,{}).get('outstanding',0)
        utilization_rate = round(factual_debt / (r.credit_limit or 1) * 100, 1)

        if coop_months >= 6 and overdue_count == 0 and on_time_rate >= 95:
            rating = "A"
        elif coop_months < 3 or overdue_count >= 3 or max_overdue_days > 30:
            rating = "C"
        else:
            rating = "B"

        data.append({
            "id": r.id, "customer_id": r.customer_id,
            "customer_name": cust_info.get("name", ""),
            "rating": rating,
            "credit_limit": r.credit_limit or 0,
            "current_debt": factual_debt, "currency":currency,
            "overdue_days": overdue_from_position(balances.get(r.customer_id,{}).get(currency,empty_position(r.customer_id,currency)),today),
            "coop_months": coop_months,
            "on_time_rate": on_time_rate,
            "total_repayments": total_repayments,
            "overdue_count": overdue_count,
            "max_overdue_days": max_overdue_days,
            "avg_monthly_repay": avg_monthly_repay,
            "utilization_rate": utilization_rate,
        })

    return {"data": data}

async def create_once(db, credit, customer, req, user):
    values = values_for(req)
    canonical = {**values, 'ship_date': req.ship_date.isoformat(), 'amount': str(req.amount.quantize(Decimal('.01'))), 'credit_id': credit.id}
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(canonical, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
    async def existing():
        return (await db.execute(select(CreditShipment).where(CreditShipment.request_key == req.request_key))).scalar_one_or_none()
    def replay(row):
        if row.credit_customer_id != credit.id or row.request_fingerprint != fingerprint:
            raise HTTPException(409, '该发货请求已保存且内容不一致，请查看原记录；新发货请重新登记')
        return row, False
    old = await existing()
    if old: return replay(old)
    await validate_new_value(db, credit, customer, values)
    insert = sqlite_insert if db.bind.dialect.name == 'sqlite' else pg_insert
    sid = (await db.execute(insert(CreditShipment).values(**values, credit_customer_id=credit.id,
        entrant_id=user.id, status='active', request_key=req.request_key, request_fingerprint=fingerprint)
        .on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=['request_key']).returning(CreditShipment.id))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if sid is None: return replay(await existing())
    if credit.currency is None: credit.currency = values['currency']
    row = await db.get(CreditShipment, sid)
    await record_history(db, module='credit', record_id=sid, operator=user, operation_type='create',
        after={'shipment': shipment_dict(row, credit, customer)}, warehouse_id=credit.warehouse_id)
    return row, True

    await db.flush()
    from app.services.customer_receivables import legacy_review

@router.get("/dashboard")
async def credit_dashboard(request: Request, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
                           db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
                           _perm=Depends(check_staff_permission("账期管理"))):
    # 全局统计
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    # Get all active credit customers for this warehouse and compute debt in realtime (batch)
    scope = [w.id for w in await warehouse_scope(db, current_user, request.headers.get('X-Warehouse-ID'))]
    cust_query = select(CreditCustomer).where(CreditCustomer.warehouse_id.in_(scope))
    if current_user.role != Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        cust_query = cust_query.where(CreditCustomer.warehouse_id.in_(get_wh_ids(current_user)))
    all_credits = (await db.execute(cust_query)).scalars().all()
    total_cust = len(all_credits)
    fact_balances = await positions(db,scope,[c.customer_id for c in all_credits],sources=True)
    customer_map = {r.id:r for r in (await db.execute(select(Customer).where(Customer.id.in_({c.customer_id for c in all_credits})))).scalars()}
    overdue_count = sum(1 for c in all_credits if c.status == CreditStatus.ACTIVE.value and
        overdue_from_position(fact_balances.get(c.customer_id,{}).get(
            currency_of(c,customer_map[c.customer_id]),empty_position(c.customer_id,c.currency or 'THB')),thai_today()) > 0)

    # Rating distribution
    try:
        assessment_result = await _compute_assessment(current_user, db)
        rating_dist = {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0}
        for item in assessment_result["data"]:
            r = item.get("rating", "B")
            rating_dist[r] = rating_dist.get(r, 0) + 1
    except Exception as e:
        import logging
        logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(f"评级计算失败: {e}")
        rating_dist = {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0}

    customers = {c.id: c for c in (await db.execute(select(Customer).where(Customer.id.in_({c.customer_id for c in all_credits})))).scalars().all()}
    currency_totals = {cur:{'total_debt':0,'total_credit_limit':0} for groups in fact_balances.values() for cur in groups}
    for c in all_credits:
        customer = customers.get(c.customer_id)
        if not customer or customer.warehouse_id != c.warehouse_id: continue
        cur = currency_of(c, customer)
        group = currency_totals.setdefault(cur, {'total_debt': 0, 'total_credit_limit': 0})
        group['total_credit_limit'] += c.credit_limit or 0
    for cur,group in currency_totals.items():
        group['total_debt'] = round(sum(groups.get(cur,{}).get('outstanding',0) for groups in fact_balances.values()), 2)
        group['total_credit_limit'] = round(group['total_credit_limit'],2)
        group['utilization_rate'] = round(group['total_debt'] / group['total_credit_limit'] * 100, 1) if group['total_credit_limit'] else 0
    # 旧单币种字段兼容；混合币种不能伪装成一个泰铢合计。
    total_debt = next(iter(currency_totals.values()))['total_debt'] if len(currency_totals)==1 else None if currency_totals else 0
    total_limit = next(iter(currency_totals.values()))['total_credit_limit'] if len(currency_totals)==1 else None if currency_totals else 0

    return {
        "currency_totals": currency_totals, "total_debt": float(total_debt) if total_debt is not None else None, "total_credit_limit": float(total_limit) if total_limit is not None else None,
        "total_customers": total_cust or 0, "overdue_count": overdue_count,
        "utilization_rate": round(float(total_debt or 0) / float(total_limit or 1) * 100, 1) if total_limit else 0,
        "rating_dist": rating_dist,
    }

    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    if current_user.role not in (Role.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN, Role.SUPERVISOR, Role.STAFF):
        raise HTTPException(403, "无权限")

    result = await _compute_assessment(current_user, db)
    data = result["data"]

    rating_labels = {"A": "A级-优质客户", "B": "B级-正常客户", "C": "C级-风险客户"}
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "账期客户评估"
    ws.append(["客户名称", "评级", "信用额度", "当前欠款", "逾期天数", "还款准时率(%)",

async def validate_market_image(db, user, image):
    if not image:
        return
    from pathlib import Path
    from app.api.secure_uploads import upload_root, may_read, has_private_reference
    target = image.lstrip("/")
    parts = Path(target).parts
    path = upload_root().joinpath(*parts[1:]).resolve()
    if (len(parts) < 3 or parts[0] != "uploads" or not parts[1].isdigit() or ".." in parts
        or not path.is_relative_to(upload_root()) or not path.is_file()
        or path.suffix.lower() not in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp")):
        raise HTTPException(400, "请上传有效的市场商品图片")
    if await has_private_reference(db, target) or not await may_read(db, user, target):
        raise HTTPException(403, "市场图片不能引用业务附件或他人未发布的图片")

async def report(db, warehouse_ids, start, end):
    costs, flows = cost_query(db, warehouse_ids), flow_query(db, warehouse_ids)
    cf, ff = cost_filters(costs, start, end), flow_filters(flows, start, end)
    cost_groups = (await db.execute(select(costs.c.currency, costs.c.category_name, func.count(), func.sum(costs.c.amount))
        .where(*cf).group_by(costs.c.currency, costs.c.category_name))).all()
    known = (await db.execute(select(flows.c.account_id, flows.c.currency, flows.c.type, func.sum(flows.c.amount))
        .where(*ff, flows.c.status == "active").group_by(flows.c.account_id, flows.c.currency, flows.c.type))).all()
    accounts = (await db.execute(select(PaymentAccount).where(PaymentAccount.warehouse_id.in_(warehouse_ids)).order_by(PaymentAccount.id))).scalars().all()
    from app.services.account_balances import balances_at
    opening_balances = await balances_at(db, accounts, start)
    anchor = thai_today().replace(day=1)
    period = defaultdict(lambda: {"income": ZERO, "expense": ZERO})
    for aid, cur, kind, value in known: period[(aid, cur)][kind] += money(value)
    loans = (await db.execute(select(CashAdvance).where(CashAdvance.warehouse_id.in_(warehouse_ids),
        CashAdvance.advance_date >= start, CashAdvance.advance_date <= end, CashAdvance.status.in_(["confirmed", "repaid"])))) .scalars().all()
    used = (await db.execute(select(costs).where(*cf, costs.c.funding_source.in_(["cash_advance", "expense_fund"])).order_by(costs.c.date, costs.c.source_id))).mappings().all()
    currencies = sorted({"THB", "CNY"} | {c for c, *_ in cost_groups} | {c for _, c, *_ in known} | {a.currency or "THB" for a in accounts} | {r.currency for r in loans})
    blocks = []
    for cur in currencies:
        categories = {name: {"name": name, "count": count, "amount": float(money(value))} for c, name, count, value in cost_groups if c == cur}
        for name in ("员工工资", "报销", "采购", "备用金拨付"): categories.setdefault(name, {"name": name, "count": 0, "amount": 0.0})
        ordered = [categories.pop(name) for name in ("员工工资", "报销", "采购", "备用金拨付")]
        ordered += [categories[k] for k in sorted(categories)]
        cost_total = sum((money(r["amount"]) for r in ordered), ZERO)
        account_rows = []
        for a in accounts:
            if (a.currency or "THB") != cur: continue
            opening = opening_balances[a.id]
            movements = period[(a.id, cur)]
            account_rows.append({"account_id": a.id, "account_name": a.account_name, "opening_balance": float(opening),
                "inflow": float(movements["income"]), "outflow": float(movements["expense"]),
                "closing_balance": float(opening + movements["income"] - movements["expense"]), "status": a.status or "active"})
        unmapped = period[(None, cur)]
        unassigned = {"inflow": float(unmapped["income"]), "outflow": float(unmapped["expense"])}
        people = {}
        for r in loans:
            if r.currency != cur: continue
            key = f"user:{r.payer_id}" if r.payer_id is not None else f"name:{r.payer_name}"
            g = people.setdefault(key, {"key": key, "payer_id": r.payer_id, "payer_name": r.payer_name,
                "amount": ZERO, "repaid_amount": ZERO, "outstanding_amount": ZERO, "count": 0})
            g["amount"] += r.amount; g["repaid_amount"] += r.repaid_amount; g["outstanding_amount"] += r.amount - r.repaid_amount; g["count"] += 1
        debt_rows = [{**r, **{k: float(r[k]) for k in ("amount", "repaid_amount", "outstanding_amount")}} for r in people.values()]
        details = [{**dict(r), "amount": float(r["amount"]), "date": str(r["date"])} for r in used if r["currency"] == cur]
        advance_used = sum((money(r["amount"]) for r in details if r["funding_source"] == "cash_advance"), ZERO)
        fund_used = sum((money(r["amount"]) for r in details if r["funding_source"] == "expense_fund"), ZERO)
        outgoing = money((await db.execute(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(flows.c.amount), 0)).where(
            *ff, flows.c.currency == cur, flows.c.type == "expense", flows.c.status == "active",
            flows.c.is_internal_transfer.is_(False)))).scalar_one())
        non_costs = (await db.execute(select(flows.c.source_label, func.count(), func.sum(flows.c.amount)).where(
            *ff, flows.c.currency == cur, flows.c.status == "active", flows.c.type == "expense", flows.c.is_non_cost_flow.is_(True),
        ).group_by(flows.c.source_label))).all()
        difference = cost_total - outgoing
        residual = difference - advance_used - fund_used
        blocks.append({"currency": cur, "symbol": "¥" if cur == "CNY" else "฿", "costs": {"data": ordered,
            "count": sum(r["count"] for r in ordered), "total": float(cost_total)},
            "funds": {"data": account_rows, "total": {k: float(sum((money(r[k]) for r in account_rows), ZERO)) for k in ("opening_balance", "inflow", "outflow", "closing_balance")}, "unassigned": unassigned},
            "debt": {"data": debt_rows, "total": {k: float(sum((money(r[k]) for r in debt_rows), ZERO)) for k in ("amount", "repaid_amount", "outstanding_amount")}},
            "reconciliation": {"cost_total": float(cost_total), "company_outflow": float(outgoing), "difference": float(difference),
                "cash_advance_cost": float(advance_used), "expense_fund_cost": float(fund_used), "non_company_cost": float(advance_used + fund_used),
                "unreconciled_difference": float(residual), "balanced": residual == ZERO,
                "non_cost_outflows": [{"name": name, "count": count, "amount": float(money(value))} for name, count, value in non_costs],
                "details": details, "detail_count": len(details)}})
    undated = (await db.execute(select(flows.c.currency, flows.c.source_label, func.count(), func.sum(flows.c.amount))
        .where(flows.c.date.is_(None), flows.c.status == "active").group_by(flows.c.currency, flows.c.source_label))).all()
    from app.services.internal_transfers import transfer_summary
    transfers = await transfer_summary(db, warehouse_ids, start, end)
    return {"internal_transfers": transfers, "start_date": start.isoformat(), "end_date": end.isoformat(), "warehouse_ids": warehouse_ids, "currencies": blocks,

                                      current_user: User = Depends(check_staff_permission(MENU_PERMISSIONS_BY_KEY["reports"].label)), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):

        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    from sqlalchemy import and_, case
    r,f,d = ReconciliationResult,IncomingFlow,RechargeDeclaration
    cur = case((and_(f.currency.is_not(None),d.currency.is_not(None),f.currency!=d.currency),"UNKNOWN"),
        else_=func.coalesce(f.currency,d.currency,"UNKNOWN"))
    query = (scoped_query(db,scope,r)
        .outerjoin(f,and_(f.id==r.flow_id,f.warehouse_id==r.warehouse_id))
        .outerjoin(d,and_(d.id==r.declaration_id,d.warehouse_id==r.warehouse_id)))
    query = query.where(r.reconciliation_month>=scope.start.strftime("%Y-%m"),r.reconciliation_month<=scope.end.strftime("%Y-%m"))
    records = (await db.execute(query.add_columns(cur.label("currency")).order_by(r.id))).all()

        "币种":currency,"处理说明":item.handling_note or ""} for item,currency in records]
    amounts={}
    for item,currency in records:amounts[currency]=round(amounts.get(currency,0)+abs(item.amount_diff or 0),2)

        "total_diff":total_diff,"total_diff_by_currency":amounts,"total_count":len(records)}

async def report_previews(
    start_date: str = None, end_date: str = None,
    scope: ReportScope = Depends(selected_report_scope),

):
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    from sqlalchemy import case
    from app.services.wallet import totals, grouped_totals
    async def preview(query, model, value, *, basis="period"):
        cur = func.coalesce(model.currency, "THB")
        rows = (await db.execute(query.with_only_columns(cur,func.sum(value),func.count(model.id))
            .group_by(cur).order_by(cur))).all()
        amounts = {c:round(float(n or 0),2) for c,n,count in rows}
        return {"preview_by_currency":amounts,
            "preview":next(iter(amounts.values())) if len(amounts)==1 else None if amounts else 0,
            "count":sum(count for c,n,count in rows),"period_basis":basis}
    previews = {}
    previews["recharge-summary"] = await preview(scoped_query(db,scope,RechargeDeclaration,RechargeDeclaration.declare_date),
        RechargeDeclaration,RechargeDeclaration.amount)
    previews["incoming-summary"] = await preview(scoped_query(db,scope,IncomingFlow,IncomingFlow.received_date),IncomingFlow,IncomingFlow.amount)
    summary = grouped_totals(await totals(db,scope.warehouse_ids,scope.start,scope.end))
    previews["income-expense"] = {**summary,"preview":summary["net"],"preview_by_currency":summary["net_by_currency"],"period_basis":"period"}
    # Same confirmed-order and payable-state filters as the detail's pending total.
    pending = case((PayableBill.status.in_(["pending","partially_paid","overdue"]),
        PayableBill.amount-func.coalesce(PayableBill.paid_amount,0)),else_=0)
    previews["payable"] = await preview(payable_query(db,scope),PayableBill,pending)
    previews["expense-fund"] = await preview(scoped_query(db,scope,ExpenseFund),ExpenseFund,
        case((ExpenseFund.status=="active",ExpenseFund.remaining_balance),else_=0),basis="current")
    previews["reimbursement"] = await preview(scoped_query(db,scope,Reimbursement,Reimbursement.submit_date),Reimbursement,Reimbursement.total_amount)
    # Current receivable positions retain the detail's customer set and existing formula.
    credit = await credit_report(current_user=current_user,db=db,scope=scope)
    amounts = credit["total_debt_by_currency"]
    previews["credit"] = {"preview_by_currency":amounts,"preview":credit["total_debt"],
        "count":len(credit["data"]),"period_basis":"current"}
    differences = await reconciliation_diff_report(current_user=current_user,db=db,scope=scope)
    previews["reconciliation-diff"] = {"preview_by_currency":differences["total_diff_by_currency"],
        "preview":differences["total_diff"],"count":differences["total_count"],"period_basis":"month"}
    return {"previews":previews,"start_date":str(scope.start),"end_date":str(scope.end),"warehouse_ids":scope.warehouse_ids}

async def report(db, warehouse_ids, start, end, *, customer_id=None, currency=None, shipment_page=1, cost_page=1, page_size=20):
    customers=(await db.execute(select(Customer).where(Customer.warehouse_id.in_(warehouse_ids)).order_by(Customer.id))).scalars().all()
    if customer_id is not None and customer_id not in {c.id for c in customers}:raise HTTPException(403,'无权查看所选客户')
    ids=[customer_id] if customer_id is not None else [c.id for c in customers]
    balances=await positions(db,warehouse_ids,ids,start_date=start,end_date=end,sources=True)
    reviews=await legacy_review(db,warehouse_ids,ids)
    names={c.id:c.company_name for c in customers}
    all_events=[{**e,'customer_id':cid,'customer_name':names.get(cid,'')} for cid,groups in balances.items() for cur,p in groups.items()
        if not currency or cur==currency for e in p['events']]
    shipments=sorted([e for e in all_events if e['source']=='shipment'],key=lambda e:(e['date'],e['source_id']),reverse=True)
    refs=await cost_references(db,warehouse_ids,start,end,currency) if customer_id is None else []
    wallet_rows=await totals(db,warehouse_ids,start,end) if customer_id is None else []
    wallet=grouped_totals([r for r in wallet_rows if not currency or r[0]==currency]) if customer_id is None else None
    currencies=sorted({currency} if currency else {'THB','CNY'}|{cur for groups in balances.values() for cur in groups}|{r['currency'] for r in refs})
    blocks=[]
    for cur in currencies:
        events=[e for e in all_events if e['currency']==cur]
        own_ship=[e for e in events if e['source']=='shipment'];received=[e for e in events if e['source']=='incoming']
        groups=[g[cur] for g in balances.values() if cur in g]
        daily={}
        for e in events:
            d=daily.setdefault(e['date'],{'date':e['date'],'shipment_income':money(0),'actual_receipts':money(0)})
            d['shipment_income' if e['source']=='shipment' else 'actual_receipts']+=money(e['amount'])
        blocks.append({'currency':cur,'shipment_income':float(sum((money(e['amount']) for e in own_ship),money(0))),
            'shipment_records':len(own_ship),'order_count':sum(e['order_count'] or 0 for e in own_ship),
            'unknown_order_count_records':sum(e['order_count'] is None for e in own_ship),
            'actual_receipts':float(sum((money(e['amount']) for e in received),money(0))),
            'receivable_asof':float(sum((money(p['outstanding']) for p in groups),money(0))),
            'prepayment_asof':float(sum((money(p['prepayment']) for p in groups),money(0))),
            'attributed_cost_total':None,'operating_profit':None,'profit_computable':False,
            'profit_reason':'经营成本归期和完整性未确认；不能把付款或缺失记录当作完整成本。',
            'daily':[{**r,'shipment_income':float(r['shipment_income']),'actual_receipts':float(r['actual_receipts'])} for _,r in sorted(daily.items())]})
    def page(rows,n):return {'data':rows[(n-1)*page_size:n*page_size],'total':len(rows),'page':n,'page_size':page_size}
    return {'start_date':str(start),'end_date':str(end),'warehouse_ids':warehouse_ids,'customer_id':customer_id,
        'currency':currency,'currencies':blocks,'shipments':page(shipments,shipment_page),'cost_references':page(refs,cost_page),

@router.get("/rates/query")
async def query_rate(
    at_time: str = None,
    from_currency: str = "CNY",
    to_currency: str = "THB",
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    """查询某个时间点的有效汇率。不传 at_time 则返回最新汇率。"""
    if current_user.role == Role.SUPER_ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "超级管理员请使用各仓库管理员账号操作")
    wh_id = get_wh_id(current_user)

    target_time = datetime.fromisoformat(at_time) if at_time else datetime.utcnow()

    # 找到 <= target_time 且币种匹配的最新一条记录
    query = (
        select(ExchangeRate)
        .where(
            ExchangeRate.warehouse_id.in_(get_wh_ids(current_user)),
            ExchangeRate.from_currency == from_currency,
            ExchangeRate.to_currency == to_currency,
            ExchangeRate.effective_from <= target_time,
        )
        .order_by(desc(ExchangeRate.effective_from))
        .limit(1)
    )
    result = await db.execute(query)
    rate = result.scalar_one_or_none()

    if not rate:
        # Fallback: return the closest rate without time constraint
        fallback = await db.execute(
            select(ExchangeRate)
            .where(
                ExchangeRate.warehouse_id.in_(get_wh_ids(current_user)),
                ExchangeRate.from_currency == from_currency,
                ExchangeRate.to_currency == to_currency,
            )
            .order_by(desc(ExchangeRate.effective_from))
            .limit(1)
        )
        rate = fallback.scalar_one_or_none()

    if not rate:
        raise HTTPException(404, f"未找到 {from_currency} → {to_currency} 的汇率记录")

    return {
        "rate": rate.rate,
        "from_currency": rate.from_currency,
        "to_currency": rate.to_currency,
        "effective_from": rate.effective_from.isoformat() if rate.effective_from else None,
    }

async def _calc_payroll(db: AsyncSession, current_user: User, wh_id: int, req: CalculateRequest):
    """核心工资计算（周期/单人/离职共用）。wh_id 已由调用方校验。"""
    prep = await _prepare_payroll(db, current_user, wh_id, req)
    if prep.get("early_return") is not None:
        return prep["early_return"]

    _validate_prep(prep)

    period = prep["period"]
    cap_note = prep["cap_note"]
    skipped_notes = prep["skipped_notes"]
    grace_days = prep.get("grace_days") or []

    records = await _compute_employee_records(db, wh_id, req, prep)

    await db.flush()
    msg = f"已为 {len(records)} 名员工计算 {period} 工资"
    if cap_note:
        msg += "；" + cap_note
    if skipped_notes:
        msg += "；" + "；".join(skipped_notes)
    if grace_days:
        msg += f"；本次有 {len(grace_days)} 天还在24小时宽限期内，没有判旷工，也没有发钱；如果后来确认是旷工，请对这张单点重算"
    return {
        "message": msg,
        "period": period,
        "record_count": len(records),
        "skipped": skipped_notes,
    }

@router.post("/{employee_id}/resign")
async def resign_employee(
    employee_id: int,
    req: ResignRequest,
    current_user: User = Depends(check_staff_permission(_PERMISSION)),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _payroll_permission: User = Depends(check_staff_permission(MENU_PERMISSIONS_BY_KEY["payroll"].label)),
):
    if current_user.role not in (Role.SUPER_ADMIN, Role.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN, Role.SUPERVISOR, Role.STAFF):
        raise HTTPException(403, "只有仓库管理员可以操作")
    
    e = (await db.execute(select(Employee).where(Employee.id == employee_id))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not e:
        raise HTTPException(404, "员工不存在")
    
    wh_ids = get_wh_ids(current_user)
    if e.warehouse_id not in wh_ids:
        raise HTTPException(403, "只能操作自己仓库的员工")
    
    # Parse resignation date
    try:
        resign_dt = datetime.strptime(req.resignation_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except:
        raise HTTPException(400, "日期格式错误，应为 YYYY-MM-DD")

    # Capture original status for payroll calculation & 人效时薪估算
    emp_original_status = e.status
    if emp_original_status != "resigned":
        e.pre_resign_status = emp_original_status

    # 自动结算：调用工资页面同一套计算逻辑（员工ID + 结算截止日=离职日）
    payroll_msg = ""
    try:
        from app.api.v1.payroll import _calc_payroll, CalculateRequest
        period = resign_dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
        half = "first_half" if resign_dt.day <= 15 else "second_half"
        r = await _calc_payroll(
            db, current_user, e.warehouse_id,
            CalculateRequest(period=period, half=half, employee_ids=[employee_id], end_date=req.resignation_date, is_resignation=True),
        )
        if r.get("record_count", 0) > 0:
            payroll_msg = f"，已生成离职结算工资单（结算到 {resign_dt.isoformat()}）"
        else:
            # 本期已经结算过（记录数 0）：不是错误，照常办离职
            payroll_msg = f"，本期工资已结算过，跳过"
    except HTTPException:
        # 真正结算失败（缺薪资/扣款模板、打卡不完整等）：不标离职，原样返回原因
        raise
    except Exception as ex:
        raise HTTPException(400, f"离职结算失败：{str(ex)}")

    # Update employee
    e.status = "resigned"
    e.resignation_date = resign_dt
    e.resignation_reason = req.reason
    e.resignation_note = req.note
    if req.blacklisted:
        e.blacklisted = True
        e.blacklist_reason = req.blacklist_reason or "被辞退"

    # Disable linked user account
    linked_user = await _find_linked_user(db, e)

@router.get("/{employee_id}/summary")
async def employee_summary(
    employee_id: int,
    month: str = None,
    current_user: User = Depends(check_staff_permission(_PERMISSION)),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Return attendance & salary summary for an employee"""
    if current_user.role not in (Role.SUPER_ADMIN, Role.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN, Role.SUPERVISOR, Role.STAFF):
        raise HTTPException(403, "无权限")

    wh_ids = get_wh_ids(current_user)
    emp = (await db.execute(
        select(Employee).where(Employee.id == employee_id, Employee.warehouse_id.in_(wh_ids))
    )).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not emp:
        raise HTTPException(404, "员工不存在")

    today = datetime.now()
    if not month:
        month = today.strftime("%Y-%m")

    from app.models.clock_in_records import ClockInRecord
    from app.models.overtime import OvertimeAssignment, OvertimeTask
    from app.models.payroll import PayrollRecord

    # Find linked user
    uid = emp.user_id
    if not uid:
        u = await _find_linked_user(db, emp)
        uid = u.id if u else None

    # Attendance summary
    late_count = 0
    attendance_days = 0
    if uid:
        ym_start = datetime.strptime(f"{month}-01", "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        if ym_start.month == 12:
            ym_end = ym_start.replace(year=ym_start.year+1, month=1, day=1)
        else:
            ym_end = ym_start.replace(month=ym_start.month+1, day=1)
        records = (await db.execute(
            select(ClockInRecord).where(
                ClockInRecord.user_id == uid,
                ClockInRecord.clock_date >= ym_start,
                ClockInRecord.clock_date < ym_end,
            )
        )).scalars().all()
        dates_with_records = set()
        for r in records:
            dates_with_records.add(r.clock_date)
            if r.status in ("late_half", "late_one"):
                late_count += 1
        attendance_days = len(dates_with_records)

    # Overtime hours this month
    ot_hours = 0.0
    if uid:
        ym_start = datetime.strptime(f"{month}-01", "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        if ym_start.month == 12:
            ym_end = ym_start.replace(year=ym_start.year+1, month=1, day=1)
        else:
            ym_end = ym_start.replace(month=ym_start.month+1, day=1)
        ot_result = (await db.execute(
            select(func.sum(OvertimeTask.hours))
            .join(OvertimeAssignment, OvertimeAssignment.overtime_id == OvertimeTask.id)
            .where(
                OvertimeAssignment.user_id == uid,
                OvertimeAssignment.confirmed == True,
                OvertimeTask.date >= ym_start,
                OvertimeTask.date < ym_end,
            )
        )).scalar()
        ot_hours = round(ot_result or 0, 1)

    # Payroll records：排除作废，取该月所有有效单，按结算结束日排序
    payroll_records = (await db.execute(
        select(PayrollRecord).where(
            PayrollRecord.employee_id == employee_id,
            PayrollRecord.period == month,
            PayrollRecord.voided == False,
        ).order_by(PayrollRecord.settle_end_date.asc(), PayrollRecord.id.asc())
    )).scalars().all()

    payroll_total = 0.0
    payroll_details = []
    for pr in payroll_records:
        payroll_total = round(payroll_total + (pr.net_pay or 0), 2)
        payroll_details.append({
            "id": pr.id,
            "settle_start_date": pr.settle_start_date.isoformat() if pr.settle_start_date else None,
            "settle_end_date": pr.settle_end_date.isoformat() if pr.settle_end_date else None,
            "status": pr.status,
            "disbursed": pr.disbursed,
            "net_pay": pr.net_pay,
        })
    # 一张有效的单都没有 → 合计返回空(None)，前端据此显示横杠而不是 0
    if not payroll_records:
        payroll_total = None

    # 保留原单条字段，取最后一张（按结算结束日），防止别处还在用
    payroll_data = None
    if payroll_records:
        last = payroll_records[-1]
        payroll_data = {
            "id": last.id,
            "status": last.status,
            "disbursed": last.disbursed,
            "net_pay": last.net_pay,
            "base_pay": last.base_pay,
            "overtime_pay": last.overtime_pay,
            "late_penalty": last.late_penalty,
        }

    return {
        "employee_id": employee_id,
        "employee_name": emp.name,
        "month": month,
        "attendance_days": attendance_days,
        "late_count": late_count,
        "overtime_hours": ot_hours,
        "payroll": payroll_data,
        "payroll_total": payroll_total,
        "payroll_details": payroll_details,
    }

def employee_access(*permissions, self_only=False):
    """Only explicitly registered routes accept view=self; management stays gated."""
    management = check_staff_permission_any(*permissions)

    async def dependency(request: Request, user=Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
        requested = self_only or user.role == Role.WAREHOUSE_LABOR or request.query_params.get('view') == 'self'
        if requested:
            if user.role != Role.WAREHOUSE_LABOR and not attendance_supervisor(user):
                if self_only and permissions:
                    await management(user)
                raise HTTPException(403, '无权限' if self_only else '无此操作权限')
            emp = await own_employee(db, user)
            if not emp:
                raise HTTPException(403, t('employee_not_found_contact_admin', get_request_lang(request)))
            # Personal identity is independent of spoofed selected warehouse or employee query parameters.
            user._employee_view = True
            user._attendance_employee = emp
            user._active_wh_id = emp.warehouse_id
            user._warehouse_ids = [emp.warehouse_id]
            return user
        return await management(user)
    return dependency

    si = SESSIONS[session]

    # Check duplicate
    existing = (await db.execute(
        select(ClockInRecord).where(
            ClockInRecord.user_id == current_user.id,
            ClockInRecord.warehouse_id == get_wh_id(current_user),
            ClockInRecord.clock_date == today,
            ClockInRecord.session == session,
        )
    )).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        return {"message": t("already_clocked", lang, label=label), "clocked_in_at": existing.clocked_in_at.isoformat(), "duplicate": True}

    # Save photo
    photo_path = None
    if photo_base64:
        # 解码校验（在 try 之外，确保格式错误能正确报错而不是被吞掉）
        try:
            _, data = photo_base64.split(",", 1) if "," in photo_base64 else ("", photo_base64)
            img_bytes = base64.b64decode(data)
        except Exception:
            raise HTTPException(400, t("invalid_photo", lang))
        try:
            from app.services.image_utils import save_image
            wh_id = str(get_wh_id(current_user) or 0)
            today_str = today.isoformat()
            abs_subdir = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, wh_id, today_str, "clockin")

            fname = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.jpg"

            photo_path = result["path"]
        except Exception:
            pass

    wh_id = get_wh_id(current_user)
    late_half_time, late_one_time = await _get_late_thresholds(db, current_user)
    penalty = _get_penalty(session, now, late_half_time, late_one_time)
    record = ClockInRecord(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        warehouse_id=wh_id,
        clock_date=today,
        session=session,
        clocked_in_at=now,
        photo_path=photo_path,
        status=penalty["status"],
        penalty_amount=0,  # computed at payroll time
    )
    db.add(record)
    await db.flush()

    if penalty["status"] == "late_one":

        "status": penalty["status"],
        "penalty_amount": 0,
        "photo_path": photo_path,
    }

):
    lang = get_request_lang(request)

    today = thai_today()
    records = (await db.execute(
        select(ClockInRecord).where(

            ClockInRecord.warehouse_id == get_wh_id(current_user),
            ClockInRecord.clock_date == today,
        ).order_by(ClockInRecord.session)
    )).scalars().all()
    completed = {r.session: {
        "session": r.session, "label": session_label(r.session, lang),
        "clocked_in_at": r.clocked_in_at.isoformat(), "status": r.status,
        "penalty_amount": r.penalty_amount, "photo_path": r.photo_path,
        "photo_thumb_path": thumb_path_of(r.photo_path),
    } for r in records}
    session_times = await get_session_times(db, get_wh_id(current_user))

    # 迟到罚款预览：本人时薪 + 迟到半小时/1小时扣款金额（找不到档案/模板时返回空）
    hourly_rate = None
    late_half_amount = None
    late_one_amount = None
    wh_id = get_wh_id(current_user)
    if wh_id:
        from app.models.employee import Employee

        from app.models.salary_template import SalaryTemplate
        from app.models.deduction_template import DeductionTemplate
        import calendar as _cal
        emp = (await db.execute(
            select(Employee).where(
                Employee.warehouse_id == wh_id,
                Employee.user_id == current_user.id,
                Employee.is_deleted == False,
            )
        )).scalar_one_or_none()
        if not emp:
            emp = (await db.execute(
                select(Employee).where(
                    Employee.warehouse_id == wh_id,
                    Employee.name == current_user.display_name,
                    Employee.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )).scalar_one_or_none()
        if emp and emp.salary_template_id and emp.deduction_template_id:
            tpl = (await db.execute(
                select(SalaryTemplate).where(SalaryTemplate.id == emp.salary_template_id)
            )).scalar_one_or_none()
            dtpl = (await db.execute(
                select(DeductionTemplate).where(DeductionTemplate.id == emp.deduction_template_id)
            )).scalar_one_or_none()
            if tpl and dtpl:
                amount = tpl.amount or 0
                if tpl.type == "monthly":
                    days = _cal.monthrange(today.year, today.month)[1]
                    hourly_rate = amount / days / 8.0
                else:  # hourly / daily
                    hourly_rate = amount / 8.0
                late_half_mult = dtpl.late_half_multiplier if dtpl.late_half_multiplier is not None else 0.5
                late_one_mult = dtpl.late_one_multiplier if dtpl.late_one_multiplier is not None else 1.0
                late_half_amount = round(hourly_rate * late_half_mult, 2)
                late_one_amount = round(hourly_rate * late_one_mult, 2)
                hourly_rate = round(hourly_rate, 2)

    return {
        "today": today.isoformat(),
        "sessions": [{"session": s, "label": session_label(s, lang), "time": session_times[s].strftime("%H:%M")}
                      for s in (1, 2, 3, 4)],
        "completed": completed,
        "full_day_leave": await approved_full_day_today(db, current_user, today),
        "hourly_rate": hourly_rate,
        "late_half_amount": late_half_amount,
        "late_one_amount": late_one_amount,
    }

        target = datetime.strptime(req.date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except:
        raise HTTPException(400, "日期格式错误")

    today = thai_today()
    if target > today:
        raise HTTPException(400, "不能补未来的日期")
    if (today - target).days > 60:
        raise HTTPException(400, "不能补超过60天以前的记录，请联系管理员")

    reason = (req.reason or "").strip()
    if not reason:
        raise HTTPException(400, "请填写补卡原因")

    sessions: list[int] = []
    for s in req.sessions:
        if s in SESSIONS and s not in sessions:
            sessions.append(s)
    if not sessions:
        raise HTTPException(400, "请选择要补的时段")

    emp = (await db.execute(
        select(Employee).where(Employee.id == req.employee_id, Employee.warehouse_id == wh_id, Employee.is_deleted == False)
    )).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not emp:
        raise HTTPException(404, "员工不存在")
    if emp.status == "resigned":
        raise HTTPException(400, "该员工已离职，不能补卡")

    emp_to_user, _ = await resolve_employee_user_map(db, [emp])
    uid = emp_to_user.get(emp.id)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(400, "该员工没有关联打卡账号，无法补卡")

    used_days = await _count_makeup_days(db, uid, wh_id, target)
    if used_days >= 2:
        raise HTTPException(400, "该员工本月补卡次数已用完，不能再补")

    session_times = await get_session_times(db, wh_id)
    created: list[int] = []
    overwritten: list[dict] = []
    skipped: list[dict] = []
    for s in sessions:
        dup = (await db.execute(
            select(ClockInRecord).where(ClockInRecord.user_id == uid, ClockInRecord.clock_date == target, ClockInRecord.session == s)
        )).scalar_one_or_none()
        t_std = session_times[s]
        if dup:
            if dup.status in ("late_half", "late_one"):
                # 覆盖迟到记录：时间改成标准时间、状态改成正常、标记补卡
                old_status = dup.status
                dup.clocked_in_at = datetime.combine(target, t_std, tzinfo=THAI_TZ)
                dup.status = "normal"
                dup.penalty_amount = 0
                dup.is_makeup = True
                dup.makeup_by = current_user.id
                dup.makeup_at = thai_now()
                dup.makeup_reason = reason
                overwritten.append({"session": s, "old_status": old_status, "old_status_label": LATE_STATUS_CN.get(old_status, old_status)})
            else:
                skipped.append({"session": s, "reason": "该时段已有正常记录"})
            continue
        clocked = datetime.combine(target, t_std, tzinfo=THAI_TZ)
        db.add(ClockInRecord(
            user_id=uid, warehouse_id=wh_id, clock_date=target, session=s,
            clocked_in_at=clocked, status="normal", penalty_amount=0,
            is_makeup=True, makeup_by=current_user.id, makeup_at=thai_now(), makeup_reason=reason,
        ))
        created.append(s)

    await db.flush()
    used_days = await _count_makeup_days(db, uid, wh_id, target)
    remaining = max(2 - used_days, 0)
    parts = []
    if created:
        parts.append(f"新增 {len(created)} 段")
    if overwritten:
        ov = "、".join(f"{SESSIONS[o['session']]['label']}（原{o['old_status_label']}）" for o in overwritten)
        parts.append(f"覆盖 {len(overwritten)} 段：{ov}")
    if skipped:
        sk = "、".join(f"{SESSIONS[x['session']]['label']}（{x['reason']}）" for x in skipped)
        parts.append(f"跳过 {len(skipped)} 段：{sk}")
    return {
        "message": "补卡完成：" + "；".join(parts),
        "created": created,
        "created_count": len(created),
        "overwritten": overwritten,
        "overwritten_count": len(overwritten),
        "skipped": skipped,
        "skipped_count": len(skipped),
        "used_days": used_days,
        "remaining": remaining,
    }
